tagline: The blockbuster weight-loss / GLP-1 drug wave (Ozempic, Zepbound) — one of the biggest stories in pharma. A tiny fund universe with extreme dependence on just two companies: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk.
universe_note: A brand-new, thin niche — SLIM is the main dedicated fund. The defining feature is duopoly concentration: Lilly + Novo dominate any GLP-1 basket. Broad pharma (PPH/XLV) is the diversified alternative. Market figures need a live ↻.
key_tensions: Duopoly concentration: Eli Lilly + Novo Nordisk ARE the GLP-1 market — any focused fund is effectively a leveraged two-stock bet.
Binary clinical/competitive risk: oral GLP-1s, new entrants (Amgen, Viking), and trial readouts can re-rate the whole theme overnight.
Tiny universe: ~1 dedicated US fund (SLIM) — scarcity + closure risk.
Valuation: Lilly/Novo trade at premium multiples on huge growth expectations — disappointment hits hard.
Pure-play vs broad pharma: you can get most of the GLP-1 upside from cheaper, diversified PPH/XLV without the concentration.
benchmark_note: PPH (big pharma) and XLV (broad healthcare) are the yardsticks — both already hold Lilly heavily, so they capture much of the GLP-1 upside far more cheaply and diversified.
